question: Benchmark search recall and latency on my deployed VSS search profile using the warehouse dataset.
ground_truth: Use the search benchmarking workflow, obtain the deployment endpoint and dataset location if missing, and run the non-destructive default flow before reporting measured retrieval and latency results.
expected_behavior: Activates benchmark-video-search and requests any missing endpoint or dataset location instead of guessing.
Uses the vst-direct ingest default with --skip-existing on a shared deployment and does not pass --clear or --only-dataset without an explicit deletion request.
Reports the actual retrieval paths, decomposition mode, recall, HIT@k, and available stage timings without inventing results.

question: We have no VSS deployment yet. Build what is needed and benchmark video search on my labelled warehouse dataset.
ground_truth: Hand the deployment to vss-build-vision-ai with an explicit stock search profile request that retains the in-stack agent REST API and in-stack LLM, then return to benchmarking only after endpoint readiness and dataset location are confirmed.
expected_behavior: Requests the stock search profile with its in-stack agent and in-stack LLM retained, avoiding the harness choice that removes them.
Records the reachable agent endpoint and unified origin and checks agent /health and LLM /v1/models before the benchmark run.
Asks for the dataset location if it is missing; does not invent an evaluation result.
